gloss: long period of time; extended duration

definitions.gloss: long period of time; extended duration
definitions.explanation: A prolonged stretch of time, typically weeks, months, or years.

examples.japanese: {長期間|ちょうきかん}{留守|るす}にする。
examples.english: To be away for a long period.

examples.japanese: {長期間|ちょうきかん}にわたる{交渉|こうしょう}が{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: Negotiations continued over an extended period.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}を{長期間|ちょうきかん}{服用|ふくよう}すると{副作用|ふくさよう}が{出|で}ることがある。
examples.english: Taking this medicine for a long period may cause side effects.

notes:
{長|ちょう} (long) + {期間|きかん} (period of time). Describes a stretch of time that is notably longer than usual, typically ranging from several weeks to years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}にわたる — over a long period
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}{放置|ほうち}する — leave unattended for a long time
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}{保存|ほぞん}する — store for a long period
- {長期間|ちょうきかん}{滞在|たいざい}する — stay for an extended period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長期|ちょうき} — long-term; focuses on the nature of something rather than the duration itself
- {長い間|ながいあいだ} — for a long time; more colloquial and conversational
- {長年|ながねん} — many years; specifically implies years rather than a general long period
